value: High-pressure chase balls versus the same bowler's normal-pressure chase balls.
At least 84 legal balls in both high- and normal-pressure states.
Batting runs plus bowler-attributed extras; byes, leg-byes and penalty runs excluded.
Run outs, retire outs and obstructing-the-field dismissals excluded.
High-pressure wicket rate minus normal-pressure wicket rate.
Each delta is standardized within the eligible population, then equally weighted.
Raw score multiplied by high_legal_balls / (high_legal_balls + 143); 143 is the median high-pressure exposure of eligible bowlers.
